positive_prompts.prompt: Audit our ML-DSA-65 implementation against FIPS 204: the rejection-sampling loop and its iteration bounds, hint vector computation, deterministic versus hedged signing modes, and whether verification enforces the z norm bound and hint weight limits.

Review our SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+) signing service under FIPS 205: the FORS tree addressing, WOTS+ chain computation, and whether the randomizer opt_rand is generated per the hedged variant so that signing the same message twice cannot reuse one-time key material unsafely.

Audit our XMSS signing infrastructure under NIST SP 800-208: the monotonic OTS index counter persistence across crashes and restarts, backup/restore procedures that could roll the index back, and whether signing nodes can be cloned in a way that reuses a one-time signature key.

negative_prompts.prompt: Audit our ML-KEM-768 decapsulation and implicit rejection handling against FIPS 203, including ciphertext validation and the constant-time comparison in the Fujisaki-Okamoto transform.

Review this Ed25519 signature library for canonical s range enforcement, small-order point handling, and batch versus single verification consistency. It is a classical elliptic-curve signature scheme, no post-quantum algorithms involved.
